title: D2607001 Order of Dismissal
text:
ALJ/KWZ/abb Date of Issuance 7/1/2026
Decision 26-07-001
BEFORE THE PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION OF THE STATE OF CALIFORNIA
Joseph Northington,
Complainant,
(ECP)
vs.
Case 26-03-033
Pacific Gas and Electric Company,
Defendant.
ORDER OF DISMISSAL
Upon the request of Complainant Joseph Northington, Complaint
(C) 26-03-033 is dismissed with prejudice under Pub. Util. Code §308 and
Rule 4.5, effective today.
In the Defendant’s Answer filed May 4, 2026, Defendant states they found
billing errors and sought to correct those errors, anticipating that billing
adjustments would resolve Complaint. In an e-mail dated May 12, 2026,
Complainant confirmed the joint settlement of all issues in the Complaint and
sought to dismiss the case. Good cause shown, the request to dismiss with
prejudice is granted.
Case 26-03-033 is closed.
Dated July 1, 2026, at San Francisco, California.
607218183

/s/ LEUWAM TESFAI
Leuwam Tesfai
Executive Director
